rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Campus Assistant is a comprehensive educational management MCP server built with Python and FastAPI that provides AI agents with direct access to school administration systems including student enrollment, grade management, messaging, and scheduling. The implementation integrates with MySQL databases to manage multi-school environments with class instances, parent-student relationships, memo reminders, notice broadcasting, and real-time messaging queues. It features role-based access control for students, teachers, parents, and administrators, automated daily quote delivery, open window scheduling for communication availability, and outgoing message queuing with priority handling.
